text:
noah: Need a short manager-facing one-pager + copyable 30/60/90 for a hybrid Product Designer starting Mon. Must be manager-only (not hire-facing) and include day0 logistics, quick IT checklist, buddy assignment, and a tiny measurable 30/60/90. Can someone distill to something I can DM and drop into Notion?
ivy: I can do a one-pager. Must-have bullets: confirm laptop pickup vs shipping, badge pre-approval, assign buddy, schedule Day1 setup w/IT, add to design channels, and calendar templates for first-week meetings.
leo: IT notes: imaging window Fri 5pm or Mon 810am. Image tag `rwi-design-2026`. Pre-provision Figma org + repo access before Day1. For hybrid, include desk monitor checklist and where to find dongles. Quick snippet for managers to pass to IT: ```create-employee --email {email} --teams design,product --tools figma,notion,slack```
ben: 30/60/90 (copy-paste manager version, measurable):
- 30: complete design system onboarding, 2 component PRs merged, run one usability test with notes.
- 60: own a small feature flow from discovery to shipped prototype; present findings to product and engineering; reduce handoff blockers by 25% in owned flow.
- 90: lead rollout of visual update for a minor flow; mentor buddy on design reviews; propose 1 cross-team process improvement.
hr-bot: Reminder: security training and SSO enrollment must be triggered before first day. People Ops will auto-invite once manager completes intake.
ivy: I'll add a day-by-day mini agenda (manager can paste into calendar): Day0: confirm shipping/pickup + DM template. Day1: 09:00 desk/setup + IT, 10:00 team intro, 14:00 design walkthrough. End of week: 30-min check-in + set 30-day goals.
leo: Also add a short DM template for day0 managers can send: "Hey <name> 
d excited to have you! You can pick up your laptop Mon 810am (Bldg D reception) or we can ship. Reply with preference. Bring ID for badge. See you Mon 9am for setup. 




















 - <manager>"
noah: This looks good. Keep it to one page and include two manager-only checks: schedule skip-level in week4 and confirm budget for any onboarding hardware. Can you post the final by 3pm?
ivy: Will do 
:thumbsup: I'll publish to Notion under Onboarding > Manager Kit and ping #people-ops when live.
it-bot: Badge pickup windows: Mon & Tue 8:30-10:00 at Security Desk. Please pre-register new hire email for faster processing.
hr-bot: Action items created: 1) Draft manager one-pager -> ivy, 2) Update intake form fields (shipping, breakfast RSVP, travel reimbursement) -> people-ops, 3) Pre-provision Figma + image -> leo. Due: today 15:00.
